description: This file defines register addresses, bit masks, inline functions, and constants for controlling and interfacing with the DSP Communication Widget for Intel ADSP, specifically for sideband message transmission and reception.

methods.name: cw_upstream_ready
methods.description: Checks if the endpoint state machine is idle, indicating readiness for new upstream communication.

methods.name: cw_upstream_set_attr
methods.description: Configures attributes of an upstream message including destination, function, opcode, byte enable, and base address register.

methods.name: cw_upstream_set_address16
methods.description: Sets a 16-bit address for an upstream message, resetting upper address to zero.

methods.name: cw_upstream_set_data
methods.description: Sets the data payload for an upstream message.

methods.name: cw_upstream_enable_sent_intr
methods.description: Enables or disables the message sent interrupt for upstream communication.

methods.name: cw_upstream_do_pw
methods.description: Writes a posted message with specific transaction and message type bits set.

methods.name: cw_upstream_clear_msgsent
methods.description: Clears the message sent interrupt status.

methods.name: cw_upstream_wait_for_sent
methods.description: Waits until the message has been sent, then clears the message sent status.
